verdict.rationale: Vapi has a dedicated 'understanding latency' docs page that gives tuning guidance: an 'Ultra Fast' tier of speed-optimized models versus a 'High Intelligence' tier that accepts higher latency. Its speech-configuration docs also let you control when the assistant starts and stops speaking, which bears on turn-taking speed. The pack shows no concrete end-to-end latency figures backing the speed claims, and the guidance is evidenced only by short snippets. Missing for 10: published end-to-end latency numbers or benchmarks, a detailed per-component latency breakdown (STT/LLM/TTS/network), and independent or hands-on latency measurements.
